source_cards.title: A Perceptually Inspired Single-Parameter Auditory Distance Renderer for Music Production
source_cards.bounded_conclusion: Correlated distance cues are a credible production hypothesis and the small in-study comparison favors the coupled renderer over the authors' manual baseline; exact mappings and preference do not yet generalize to rock arrangements, loudspeakers, other reverbs, or other listeners.
limits: baseline construction and randomization not detailed
individual ratings confidence intervals and inferential statistics not reported
hyper-real HF mapping is explicitly artistic

knowledge_cards.claim: Auditory distance is a correlated-cue problem; reverb amount alone is not a coherent distance model.
A deterministic macro can be one experimental factor even when it derives multiple preregistered parameters.
The renderer's exact cue mappings are implementation facts including explicitly hyper-real choices, not transferable presets.
The reported 18-of-18 preference is bounded to one author-controlled scene and comparator.

candidate_rules.apply_when: Moving a non-lead source backward while preserving a coherent section hierarchy
candidate_rules.change: One deterministic distance macro jointly deriving direct level wet balance spectral tilt and pre-delay
candidate_rules.range_origin: DAFx26 tested renderer mapping; experiment bounds not recommendations
candidate_rules.verification: Randomized full-mix A/B after global BS.1770 matching plus direct-wet diagnostics and Dmitry ratings
candidate_rules.cancel_when: Source disappears, hierarchy is damaged, preference is loudness-only, or mono/stereo stability regresses

planned_experiments.material: Project-owned verse and chorus using a backing guitar room layer or other intentionally rear-plane source
planned_experiments.b: Identical render d=0.10; expand to 0.25 only if preregistered and first step is too weak
planned_experiments.loudness_match: Preserve source-relative level cue; global post-render trim of complete excerpts to within 0.1 LU integrated BS.1770
planned_experiments.listening: Randomized labels and three repeats for verse and chorus; separate distance coherence identity and preference ratings
planned_experiments.success: B is rated farther and at least as coherent in both sections without protected-quality regression and preference survives matching
planned_experiments.cancel: Distance rating inconsistent, B merely quieter, source loses identity or attack, or masking image instability or headroom loss appears
